note: Specs from aquasolus.com/ca model pages (Technical Specification tables), November 2026. Taglines and fit notes are AquaZen's own words, written from the specs. Weights, jet counts, finishes and the Solus Guarantee checked against the AquaSolus 2026 brochure (NA).
warranty: 10 years on the shell and frame structure, 7 years on the shell surface and 2 years on parts, under the AquaSolus Solus Guarantee.

series.name: Series One
series.headline: Plug in. Find your Zen.
series.lede: Four hot tubs for 4 to 7 people that run on a standard 120V outlet, or a 40 amp line if you have one. The simplest way to start your Zen Time.
features: Soft, shaped headrests that hold your head and neck, so you can actually let go.
A gentle sheet of water into the tub. The sound alone slows you down.
Move the flow to the seats that need it most, with one turn.
Bluetooth sound with speakers in the tub. Your playlist, or nothing but the night.
Small to extra large jets fed by wide plumbing, so a big volume of warm water works your back instead of a sharp, itchy spray.
series.honest: Plug and play is simple, with one trade-off. On a regular outlet the heater and the jets share the power, so on a chilly night the water takes longer to warm back up. If you'll soak every night all year, have a look at Series Two. If you want the easiest start, this is it.

series.name: Series Two
series.headline: Full power, every night.
series.lede: Five hot tubs for 3 to 7 people with two pumps on a dedicated 60 amp line, so the heater and the jets run at full power together. Made for nightly Zen Time, all year round.
features: Two 6 BHP pumps push a high volume of water through wide plumbing, so every seat gets a deep, soft massage instead of a sharp spray.
Soft, shaped headrests that hold your head and neck, so you can actually let go.
A gentle sheet of water into the tub. The sound alone slows you down.
Move the flow to the seats that need it most, with one turn.
Bluetooth sound with speakers in the tub. Your playlist, or nothing but the night.
series.honest: A dedicated 60 amp line needs a licensed electrician, and it is worth it if you'll use the tub most nights. Already have an old hot tub line? Tell us its size in Find your Zen and we'll check whether it will work. Four of the five have a lounger; the Calma has seven upright seats for the most room.

series.name: Series Three
series.headline: The peak of Zen.
series.lede: Our most advanced hot tubs. Programmable massage, real-time water monitoring and the full EcoPure water system, in four models for 5 to 7 people.
features: A variable-speed massage pump runs sequences you choose, from slow and soft to deep.
Gecko WaterLab watches the water for you, with UV and ozone keeping it clear.
A gentle sheet of water into the tub. The sound alone slows you down.
Colour lighting inside, glowing corners outside, and built-in Bluetooth audio.
Soft, shaped headrests that hold your head and neck, so you can actually let go.
series.honest: Series Three is for people who want the best water and the best massage, and will use both. Every model needs its own 60 amp line from a licensed electrician. If the simpler controls of Series Two would make you just as happy, I'll tell you.

swimspas.name: Swim spas
swimspas.headline: Swim, train and soak. At home.
swimspas.lede: Six AquaSolus swim spas, 14 to 19 ft long, for 2 to 12 people. Swim against river jets or a 9-speed turbine, then sit back under the hydrotherapy jets when you're done.
features: River jets give a smooth, adjustable current. Professional models use a 9-speed hydraulic turbine for a wider, deeper flow.
When the workout is done, sit back under the jets and let your muscles recover.
One panel for the current, the jets, the lights and the temperature.
Colour lighting and Bluetooth audio come standard on every swim spa.
A 304 stainless steel frame, and AQ10 insulation that keeps the heat in the water instead of the air.
swimspas.honest: A swim spa is a bigger project than a hot tub. Full of water they weigh between 5,048 and 13,180 kg, so you need a proper base, a 240V supply and room to get it into the yard. We'll talk through the base, the power and the access with you before you order, so there are no surprises on delivery day.
